rules.threshold_signal: any snapshot in threshold_snapshots with breached is True and signal_type in {'performance_degradation', 'execution_drift', 'feature_drift', 'human_correction'}
rules.incident_followup: non-empty metric_name set on threshold_snapshots (breached preferred) equals {'incident_followup_required'}
rules.incident_severity: non-empty metric_name set on threshold_snapshots (breached preferred) equals {'severity1_incident_count'}

attached_to: mutation_review item (services/control-plane/bff/evolution/router.py::bff_management_evolution_journal pre-hydration and hydrated slice)

history_includes: evolution_decision and mutation_review items with decision state != 'proposed'
proposed evolution_decision and mutation_review items with evidence_class == 'threshold_signal'
auto_proposals_includes: proposed evolution_decision and mutation_review items with evidence_class != 'threshold_signal'

ac4_filter_before_pagination.description: evolution_journal_filter_by_view runs before page_slice so page_info.total, page_info.next_page_token, and data.summary (total_items, returned_items, counts_by_type, counts_by_state) describe the filtered set.
ac4_filter_before_pagination.multi_page_setup: 6 newest auto-proposal items occupying raw page 1 (page_size=2) followed by 4 older history items on raw pages 4-5; view=history&page_size=2 returns the first 2 history items on page 1 (next_page_token='2', total=4) and the remaining 2 history items on page 2 (page_token=2, next_page_token=None, total=4).

ac5_auto_proposal_counts_per_record.counting_rule: Counted once per underlying record (a proposed decision and its paired mutation_review item count as 1 decision record; each draft postmortem counts as 1 postmortem_draft record). Identical across view=all, view=history, and view=auto_proposals.

ac6_bounded_postmortem_reads_with_2027_r.mechanism: Uses list_postmortems_page from POSTMORTEM-BFF-OWNER-READ-20261104 on the postmortem owner port instead of streaming all 11 pages (2027 rows, ~5.7-8.2 MB) on every journal request. For view=history, fetches bounded non-draft postmortems and a 1-row draft probe (status=draft&page_size=1) solely to read X-Total-Count/total for auto_proposal_counts.postmortem_draft. For view=all and view=auto_proposals without narrow in-memory filters, fetches only the needed draft slice (raw_limit = offset + page_size, capped at 200) plus non-drafts for view=all, accounting for unfetched_draft_count in page_info.total and summary.

measurements_2027_real_draft_postmortems.fixture_shape: 2027 draft postmortems built with build_real_postmortem_dict (23 keys, ~2.8 KB each, 1915 titled 'Postmortem draft: BFF downstream degradation: ...') served by LivePostmortemsOwnerServer + 3 decisions (real shape 1 incident_followup, real shape 2 incident_severity, 1 approved threshold_signal)

ac7_explicit_deep_link_filters_bypass_vi.behavior: When any of decision, mutation_review, or persona is non-empty on the request, the view filter does not hide the targeted record(s), so deep links return their target record under view=all, view=history, and view=auto_proposals.
